acceptance: Decide whether to auto-merge mirror PRs after their checks or make t3:drift tolerate a pending mirror. Triage #3906. State when bot-managed issues #2471 and #3511 may be closed and stay closed.
context:
Evidence 2026-11-11: mirror PR #4114 was the first mirror merged to published-results since #3656 on 2026-10-28; every mirror in between was superseded unmerged. It carried 137 files (+186,352 lines), most of them unrelated to the change that triggered it, and needed an owner decision to merge. Merged as 4331a43a54. The ledger seed was not recut afterwards; see ledger-seed-recut-after-published-results-advance-20261111.

2026-11-17: nightly-v2 run 43916000915 (2026-11-16) t3:drift failed: 'published-results corpus is 7 path(s) behind develop' (CORPUS_NOTES.md and six tpcdi_sf1 *.manifest.json). The auto mirror PR #4286 (auto/results-mirror-9ac60f08) is open and unmerged; drift stays red until it lands. Same failure mode as this item.

Owner decision 2026-11-17: arm auto-merge on results mirror PRs once their required checks pass (the content was reviewed on develop; the mirror is a mechanical copy). Merging the open mirror #4324 is authorized.
description: Mirror PRs #3629, #3635, #3656, #3790 (closed unmerged) and #3906 (open for develop@cd374960) needed hand merging.
